`r Biocpkg("SingleR")` is an automatic annotation method for single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNAseq) data [@aran2019reference].
Given a reference dataset of samples (single-cell or bulk) with known labels, 
it labels new cells from a test dataset based on similarity to the reference.

evidence.claim_text:
Cell type annotation of single cells (SingleR). The SingleR pipeline is based on 
correlating gene expression of pure cell types with single-cell gene expression. 
SingleR can be used with any reference data set. For mouse samples, we used the 
ImmGen database, a collection of 830 microarray samples, which we classified to 
20 main cell types and further annotated to 253 subtypes12; a data set of 358 mouse 
RNA-seq samples annotated to 28 cell types collected, processed, and shared, 
courtesy of Bérénice Benayoun, can also be used. For human samples we used 
the data sets from Blueprint Epigenomics, 144 RNA-seq pure immune samples 
annotated to 28 cell types14, and Encode, 115 RNA-seq pure stroma and immune 
samples annotated to 17 cell types13. More reference data sets for mouse and 
human are available with the SingleR R package. For specific applications, smaller 
data sets can be applicable (as demonstrated in Fig. 2c).
